---
spec_id: profile-todo-cleanup
spec_content_hash: d0bf34a9bd0e038370beea890a486b669af71067d62a9e155abecb3b8f20e99d
applied_lessons: none
---

## Approach

A comment-only edit to one file. In `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`, the doc comment directly above
`export async function getProfileData(userId: string)` (read live this run, lines 52–58) ends with the stale line
`TODO: Add organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md).`. The build replaces that
line, and only that line, with one English sentence stating the actual rule:

```text
 * The profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.
```

The blank ` *` separator line before it stays, so the comment keeps its two paragraphs (what the function reads, then
the rule). Nothing else in the file changes: the signature, the E2E fixture branch (`fullName: "Development User"`,
`email: "<email>"`, `avatarUrl: null` over `DEFAULT_PERSONAL`), the two parallel queries, the error log
and the return value are byte-for-byte as they are. No test file under `features/profile/` is edited (SPEC non-goal).

The AC tests (written by `/pharn-test`, mapped in `AC-TESTS.md`) live in the repository-root `__tests__/` directory, NOT
under `features/profile/`. This is load-bearing: AC-1 searches every file under `features/profile/` for the text
"multi-workspace support" and for a TODO naming an organizationId parameter, so an AC test placed there would contain
those very strings and fail AC-1 forever; AC-3 runs the profile unit tests in a child Vitest, and an AC test inside
`features/profile/` would also be picked up by that child run and recurse. The root `__tests__/*.test.ts` files run in
the `node` Vitest project (`vitest.config.ts` include `**/__tests__/**/*.{test,spec}.ts`), the precedent being
`__tests__/core63-data-retention-docs.ac.test.ts`.

## Applied lessons

- none — `check-lessons-index.mjs --verdict` printed `NO_CANON`: the project has no memory-bank lessons yet, so there is
  nothing to apply.

## Steps

1. Edit `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`: replace the doc-comment line
   ` * TODO: Add organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md).` with
   ` * The profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id.` (backticks around
   `getProfileData` inside the comment, as the file's other comments quote identifiers). One sentence, English.
2. Run Prettier on that one file only (`npx prettier --check features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`, then `--write`
   on the same path if needed). Prettier does not wrap comment text, and the new line (about 94 characters) is no longer
   than the TODO line it replaces, which passes `format:check` and lint today.
3. Gates: `npm run lint` (zero warnings), `npm run typecheck`, `npm run format:check`, and
   `npx vitest run features/profile/` (every existing profile unit test passes unchanged).

## Files

- `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` — the `getProfileData` doc comment: the stale TODO line replaced by the one per-person sentence; no code change

### Explicitly not touched

- `features/profile/services/__tests__/get-profile.test.ts` — existing test, must pass unchanged (SPEC non-goal)
- `features/profile/constants.ts` — `DEFAULT_PERSONAL` read by AC-4, never edited
- `CLAUDE.md` — the instructions file the TODO pointed at; SPEC non-goal
- `docs/architecture/profile.md` — architecture doc; SPEC non-goal

## Acceptance mapping

- AC-1 → Step 1 removes the only match: `grep -rn "multi-workspace\|TODO" features/profile/` this run returns exactly
  line 57 of `get-profile.ts`, so after the edit a recursive read of every file under `features/profile/` finds neither
  "multi-workspace support" nor a `TODO` line naming `organizationId`. The new sentence contains no `TODO`.
- AC-2 → Step 1 puts "The profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id." in
  the JSDoc block that ends directly above `export async function getProfileData`; the AC test extracts that block and
  checks it states per person, not per workspace, and no organization id.
- AC-3 → no test file changes and no code changes, so the profile unit tests (`features/profile/**/__tests__/*`) pass
  as they do today; the AC test runs them in a child Vitest and reads the result.
- AC-4 → the signature `getProfileData(userId: string)` is untouched (`getProfileData.length === 1`), and the E2E
  branch is untouched, so in fixture mode it returns `{ personal: { fullName: "Development User", email:
  "<email>", avatarUrl: null } }` as before.

## Risks & open questions

- **AC-3 and AC-4 already hold before the build** (ADVISORY — for `/pharn-test` and `/pharn-grill`). Their Thens (the
  existing tests pass; one parameter and the same fixture) are true of today's tree, and `/pharn-test` refuses an AC
  test that passes before the build (`ac-test-passes-before-build`, no escape hatch — the stop
  `pharn/features/gh3-connect-github/LOOP.md` records). Following the precedent in
  `pharn/features/user-billing-privacy/PLAN.md` (a precondition drawn from the AC's Given), each of those two tests
  first asserts the "after the change" state its Given names — the source of `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts`
  no longer contains "multi-workspace support" — and only then checks its Then. AC-4's Given says "after the change"
  in words; AC-3's Given ("with no test file changed") does not, so for AC-3 the precondition is the plan's reading of
  the criterion as being about the changed tree. If grill judges that precondition outside AC-3, the criterion needs
  re-specifying via `/pharn-spec`, not weakening.
- **AC-3's child Vitest** must not inherit `PHARN_TEST_RESULTS` or `VITEST_JUNIT_OUTPUT`: `vitest.config.ts` adds a JSON
  / JUnit reporter from them, and a child that inherited `PHARN_TEST_RESULTS` would overwrite the gate's own per-test
  record. The test deletes both from the child's env and asks for its own JSON report in a temp directory
  (`--reporter=json --outputFile=<tmp>`), then asserts exit 0, `numTotalTests > 0` and `numFailedTests === 0`. The child
  run of ~24 profile test files needs a per-test timeout well above the 10 s default (180 s suggested).
- **`/pharn-regress`** compares the profile tests before and after; with a comment-only change it should see no
  difference.

---
spec_id: profile-todo-cleanup
state: Approved
spec_content_hash: d0bf34a9bd0e038370beea890a486b669af71067d62a9e155abecb3b8f20e99d
approved_by: model
spec_template: pharn-default@sha256:0ac964d307ef33dc333d1eae764877b6ea5ae4006fe3fcad4dc54ed58a0478a4
---

## Intent

The doc comment of `getProfileData` in `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` still ends with "TODO: Add
organizationId parameter when multi-workspace support is added (see CLAUDE.md)". The TODO is stale: workspaces have
existed for months, the profile page is personal-only by decision (`pharn/features/profile-personal-only`),
`getProfileData` reads only one person's `user` and `user_profiles` rows, and the project instructions it points to say
nothing about it. A reader of the service today is told that a workspace parameter is pending, which is false and invites
someone to add one.

The owner wants the TODO replaced by one doc-comment sentence that states the actual rule: the profile is per person, not
per workspace, so `getProfileData` takes no organization id. Nothing the function does changes.

## Scope

**In scope:**

- Removing the stale TODO line from the `getProfileData` doc comment.
- Adding one sentence to that doc comment stating that the profile is per person, not per workspace, so `getProfileData`
  takes no organization id.

**Out of scope (non-goals):**

- Any change to `getProfileData`'s parameters, return value, E2E fixture branch, queries or error handling.
- Any change to other profile services, actions, components or the profile page.
- Editing or adding tests: the existing profile unit tests must pass unchanged.
- Editing the project instructions file or any architecture doc.

## Acceptance Criteria

- **AC-1** Given the repository after the change When every file under `features/profile/` is searched for the text
  "multi-workspace support" and for a TODO that mentions an organizationId parameter Then the search returns no match
  - verify: unit
- **AC-2** Given `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` after the change When the doc comment directly above
  `export async function getProfileData` is read Then it contains a sentence stating that the profile is per person (not
  per workspace) and that `getProfileData` takes no organization id
  - verify: unit
- **AC-3** Given the existing unit tests under `features/profile/`, with no test file changed When they are run with the
  project's Vitest runner Then every one of them passes
  - verify: unit
- **AC-4** Given the exported `getProfileData` after the change When its declared parameter count is read and it is
  called with a user id in E2E fixture mode Then it declares exactly one parameter and returns the same personal-section
  fixture it returned before the change (full name "Development User", email "<email>", no avatar URL)
  - verify: unit

## Constraints

- No behaviour change: `getProfileData`'s signature, return value and E2E branch stay exactly as they are.
- The change must keep `npm run lint` (zero warnings), `npm run typecheck` and `npm run format:check` green.
- The new doc-comment text is English and is one sentence.

## Assumptions

- The decision that the profile is per person is the one recorded by the built `pharn/features/profile-personal-only`
  increment and by the profile page living under `/user-account`, outside the workspace routes; its SPEC file still reads
  `state: Draft`, which is taken as a record-keeping gap, not as the decision being open.
- AC-1 and AC-2 are source-text properties; a unit test may observe them by reading the files under `features/profile/`
  and returning the matches, which is the returned value the Then names.
- The project's `test` script (`vitest run`) is the runner for every criterion; no e2e runner is needed.
- The E2E fixture values named in AC-4 are the ones `getProfileData` returns today, read live from
  `features/profile/services/get-profile.ts` this run.
